description: Deletes an event from the specified calendar. Only Google's HTTP 204 confirms deletion; 404 or 410 can also mean the event belongs to a different calendar. Bulk deletions may trigger `rateLimitExceeded` or `userRateLimitExceeded`; cap concurrency to 5–10 requests and apply exponential backoff.

calendar_id.description: Identifier of the Google Calendar (e.g., email address, specific ID, or 'primary' for the authenticated user's main calendar) from which the event will be deleted. Calendars without event-deletion permission, including subscribed calendars not owned by the authenticated user, return 403 on deletion attempts.
calendar_id.human_parameter_description: Tell us which calendar the event belongs to. Use the email address or calendar ID, or enter 'primary' to target your main calendar.
calendar_id.title: Calendar Id

event_id.description: Unique identifier of the event to delete. For standalone events, use the base event ID (e.g., 'abc123def456'). For recurring event instances, use the instance ID format 'baseEventId_YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ' (e.g., 'abc123def456_20260522T093000Z') where the timestamp suffix represents the instance's original start time in UTC. Instance IDs can be obtained from the EVENTS_INSTANCES action. To delete ALL occurrences of a recurring event, use the base event ID without the timestamp suffix. Must be the internal API identifier from a prior API response — UI-visible identifiers, URL-encoded variants, or shortened IDs are invalid and cause 404/validation errors.
event_id.human_parameter_description: The ID of the event you want to delete. For a single event, use its ID. For a recurring event instance, use the instance ID (format: baseEventId_YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ). To delete the entire recurring series, use the base event ID.
event_id.title: Event Id

send_notifications.description: Deprecated. Whether to send notifications about the deletion of the event. Note that some emails might still be sent.
send_notifications.title: Send Notifications

send_updates.description: Options for who should receive notifications about event changes.
send_updates.title: SendUpdates

name: delete_event

display_url.description: URL to view the resource in Google Calendar web UI. None for delete operations as the event no longer exists.
display_url.title: Display Url

response_data.description: Optional convenience wrapper returned by some integrations to indicate the outcome of the delete operation. Not part of the official Google Calendar HTTP response.
response_data.title: Response Data

status.description: Outcome of the delete operation. 'success' indicates the event was deleted successfully.
status.title: Status
